nodes.name: Webhook - PDF Upload
nodes.notes: Next.js UI posts multipart/form-data here. Expected binary field: pdf_file. Optional fields: project_name, target_slide_count, tone, audience, user_notes.

nodes.name: Validate Upload Config
nodes.notes: Validates file/config and creates run_id. Allows large PDFs if n8n/server upload limit permits.

nodes.name: Write PDF To Local Temp
nodes.notes: Stores uploaded PDF locally so the backend script can process it. Google Drive upload can be added here or after MVP verification.

nodes.name: Run Backend Pipeline
nodes.notes: Runs extraction -> AI planner -> PPTX builder. Requires project files on same host as n8n. Uses OpenRouter key from .env.

nodes.name: Parse Pipeline Result
nodes.notes: Parses backend JSON result. Contains final_pptx and run summary paths.

nodes.name: Prepare Final PPTX Binary
nodes.notes: Prepares final PPTX for Google Drive upload. Next node should upload binary final_pptx to 10 Final PPT Outputs.

nodes.name: Upload Final PPTX To Drive
nodes.notes: Upload final PPTX to PDF to PPT / 10 Final PPT Outputs. Replace credential ID/name after import.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, run_id: $json.run_id, final_ppt_file: $json.name || $json.fileName, final_ppt_drive_id: $json.id, final_ppt_link: $json.webViewLink || $json.webContentLink } }}

nodes.name: Respond With PPTX Link
nodes.notes: Returns final PPTX link to Next.js UI.

nodes.name: Error Response Placeholder
nodes.notes: Connect this through n8n error workflow or explicit error branches during implementation.

staticData.notes: Draft workflow. Replace Google Drive credentials after importing. For production, add Drive upload of source PDF, generated content, logs, and robust error workflow.
